name: ReqTools
notes: Nico François and Magnus Holmgren’s ReqTools user archive supplies the installed v38 library.

The shared library is used by installed tools including Copper-Demon, FileX, VirusZ and ADF2FMS. Their executables, preferences, icons and startup data stay with their respective packages. BCWB ships no standalone ReqTools preferences editor, profile, or L: member.
